name: Speak. Cast. Rule.
detailed_description:
Speak. Cast. Rule. is an adventure role-playing game where every NPC is controlled by AI and responds to your actions, words, magic, and reputation in real time. You play as a renegade mage in a world where all sorcery is a crime. To survive, you'll need to hide from the Inquisition, wield magic in secret or with brute force, manipulate minds, resurrect the dead, and open portals to hell. Solve puzzles, persuade characters, stay undercover — and conquer the world. But the main goal isn’t to fight — it’s to communicate, influence, deceive, persuade, and survive in a world where everyone has their own agenda. Every word and action you take is processed by AI. Some will fall for your flattery. Some will remember your face. Some will regret not burning you alive the moment they met you.

Features:

  • AI-driven characters with their own memory, motivation, and goals. They live their own lives.

  • Open world where magic is forbidden — and you’re the only mage around.

  • Freeform problem-solving: persuade, deceive, bribe, erase memories, or use portals.

  • Deep magic system: demon summoning, shapeshifting, teleportation, necromancy, alchemy.

  • Magic as a tool for social and logical challenges.

  • Dialogues and NPC reactions powered by AI APIs, not pre-written scenes.
